# Agent Daily

> Hourly reliability index of 65 APIs and MCP servers that AI agents depend on (LLMs, search, scraping, email, vector DBs, voice, payments, messaging, maps, CRM and public MCP servers). Free, no key required.

## How agents should use it
- GET https://gregpunch.github.io/agent-daily/status.json before choosing or calling a tool. Per tool: up (bool), http_status, latency_ms, vendor_status (from the vendor's status page: none=operational, minor, major, critical; null if none published), uptime_24h_pct, checks_24h.
- Also per tool: task (routing category, e.g. llm, search, scraping, email, vector-db, storage/db, payments, messaging, voice, maps, crm), kind (api|mcp), uptime_7d_pct, p50_ms, p95_ms, incidents_7d, open_incident.
- GET https://gregpunch.github.io/agent-daily/history.json for 7-day incidents per provider (outage = consecutive failed probes; vendor = status page minor/major/critical), with start/end UTC.
- Top-level: schema_version, generated_at (UTC ISO 8601), summary.up/total.
- If generated_at is older than ~2 hours, treat the data as stale.
- Please cache; fetch at most once every few minutes.

## MCP server
- Remote MCP (Streamable HTTP, no auth, read-only): https://agent-daily.agentdaily.workers.dev/mcp
- Tools: recommend(task) picks the healthiest provider for a task ('send email', 'web search', 'llm', 'scrape a page') plus fallbacks; incidents(name?, days?); list_tools(category?); tool_status(name). Backed by status.json/history.json with a 5-minute cache.

## LLM Live Probe
- https://gregpunch.github.io/agent-daily/llm/leaderboard.json: every 15 minutes ~20 popular models (via OpenRouter) get the prompt "Reply with exactly the word pong". Per model: score (0.6 correctness + 0.4 speed), correct_pct_24h, p50_ttft_ms, p50_total_ms, cost_per_1k_calls_usd, uptime_pct_24h, last result. status="awaiting_first_probe" means no data yet.
- Per model detail: https://gregpunch.github.io/agent-daily/llm/models/<id>.json (id = model slug with "/" replaced by "__"). Methods: https://gregpunch.github.io/agent-daily/llm/methods.html
- MCP tool: llm_leaderboard(sort?) with sort = score | correct | ttft | total | cost.

## Update cadence
Checks run hourly (GitHub Actions cron); the page and JSON are regenerated each run.

## Methodology limits
- Reachability only: "up" means the endpoint answered with an expected HTTP code (401/403/422 count as up for auth-gated APIs). It does NOT test correctness, quality, or rate limits.
- Single probe location (GitHub-hosted runner, US). Latency is indicative.
- Vendor status is self-reported by vendors.
